notes:
1. Dedicated Information Display Pages: Full-width dedicated Customer Profile Page and Product Profile Page with breadcrumbs, KPI summaries, and historical ledgers.
2. Compact Data Entry Modals: Clean, responsive multi-column popups with permanent field labels, required * indicators, and real-world placeholders for all create/edit workflows.
3. Pure Dynamic Tri-lingual Localization: Full elimination of bilingual bracketed text and hardcoded strings across all pages, modals, startup screen, and the 10-module Business Operating Guide.
4. Auto-Remembered D:\Laalwani app Installation Path: Default installer priority set to D:\Laalwani app, automatically detecting and updating existing installations.
5. High-Definition Pixel-Perfect A4 Invoices & Challans: Crisp Gujarati and English typography, zero mojibake corruption, multi-page pagination for 50+ items.
6. Zero-Data Pristine Production Database: Zero demo data, clean initial launch.
